desc: The Outcome combines simple style with reliable performance for everyday carry. It deploys with snappy assisted opening and the clip point blade will handle almost any work task. The knife uses expertly heat treated 8Cr13MoV blade steel and a large choil makes it easy to sharpen the edge. The Outcome locks securely in place with a steel frame lock. Added jimping delivers a secure grip while unlocking the knife. Includes deep-carry pocket clip for reversible left/right carry..
